case.summary: Case HHG-018 was initiated following an inquiry from customer C02354 regarding an in-person transaction 3491361 of $39.08 for product W on card C02354-K2 on 2016-11-27 13:41:26 in region 126. An investigation revealed that the exact $39.08 amount had appeared 11 prior times on the card under the same product code as a recurring pattern, and billing region 126 accounted for 9.6% of previous activity. Upon verification, the customer recognized the charge as their own subscription after reviewing the recurring merchant and amount history. With a calibrated fraud probability of 0.05 and no confirmed fraud among similar historical cases, the case was determined legitimate and closed with the transaction allowed.
